name: FFHQ
description: Loader-only high-resolution faces for generative evaluation: 70k images at 1024px. CelebA-HQ (30k, 1024px, Karras et al. ICLR 2018) is the companion set. FFHQ Flickr terms vary per image; no data is vendored.
citation: FFHQ: Flickr-Faces-HQ dataset, Karras et al., CVPR 2019.

license.identifier: Per-image Flickr terms; not a single SPDX identifier.
